channel.title: Bilan du monde
channel.description: World news in five minutes, every morning.

item.title: Friday, November 20, 2026 · In Shenzhen, Trump, Xi and Putin sign a "peace declaration"
item.description:
• In Shenzhen, Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin issued a "peace declaration" stating that a nuclear war cannot be won, with no concrete agreement on Ukraine or Iran.
  • Anthropic ended its first session on the Nasdaq at $97.17, 17% above its IPO price, while the Paris stock market fell 0.81%.
  • At the COP31 climate summit in Antalya, negotiations are entering their final hours with no deal secured.
  • In France, four departments were on orange alert for rain and flooding on Thursday.

item.title: Thursday, November 19, 2026 · Gulf: Iran targets a US base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain
item.description:
• On Wednesday Iran targeted a US air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain in retaliation for a US strike on Qeshm Island; Qatar condemned a "dangerous escalation".
  • In Shenzhen, Xi Jinping welcomed Donald Trump for the APEC summit, ahead of a three-way meeting with Vladimir Putin scheduled for Thursday.
  • In Antalya, ministers are trying to unblock the COP31 negotiations two days before the close, amid disagreements over fossil fuels and adaptation finance.
  • In Paris, the stock market fell 0.85% despite strong Nvidia results, and the government promised to list its priorities for a budget compromise "in the coming days".

item.title: Wednesday, November 18, 2026 · Ukraine: Crimean Bridge hit again as Kyiv's bridges are targeted
item.description:
• Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge for a second day running, while Russia targeted Kyiv's two main bridges over the Dnipro.
  • Nvidia reported quarterly revenue of $115.8 billion, its first results under interim chief executive Colette Kress.
  • Ahead of those results, markets fell sharply: the CAC 40 lost 1.62% and the Dow Jones 1.64%.
  • In France, the public-sector strike day drew 146,000 marchers according to the Interior Ministry, and more than 500,000 according to the CGT union.
  • At COP31 in Antalya, the draft final agreement is dividing delegations three days before the scheduled close.

item.title: Tuesday, November 17, 2026 · Ukraine: Moscow says it intercepted a record 1,336 drones
item.description:
• Russia says it intercepted 1,336 Ukrainian drones overnight from Sunday to Monday, which would be the largest attack of its kind since the war began.
  • Five European Union countries on Monday unveiled a deal to open a centre in Rwanda for rejected asylum seekers.
  • In France, a day of strikes and demonstrations is planned this Tuesday 17 November in the civil service, the day after a debate on poverty between five presidential candidates.
  • Wall Street fell sharply on Monday, with the Nasdaq losing 2.5% ahead of Nvidia's results.
  • In Antalya, a first draft of the COP31 deal has been published; it leaves the question of fossil fuels open.

item.title: Monday, November 16, 2026 · Hormuz: Iran says it downed a US drone, two tankers on fire
item.description:
• Iran says it shot down another US drone on Saturday and reports that two oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz.
  • In France, the Interior Ministry reports 404 arrests on the sidelines of Saturday's cost-of-living protests.
  • In Cape Verde, President José Maria Neves is reported re-elected in the first round, with nearly 64% of the vote according to provisional results.
  • On the markets, the week opens with Brent at around 95 dollars and Anthropic's stock market debut expected on Thursday.
  • In football, France beat Turkey 2-1 in Bordeaux and qualify for the Nations League quarter-finals.

item.title: Sunday, November 15, 2026 · Trump, Xi and Putin to hold three-way meeting in Shenzhen on Thursday
item.description:
• The White House has announced a first three-way meeting between Donald Trump, Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, on Thursday 19 November in Shenzhen, on the sidelines of the APEC summit.
  • Volodymyr Zelensky says US negotiators raised the idea of NATO membership for Ukraine in exchange for a withdrawal from Donbas, which he rejects.
  • In France, the fifth Saturday of protests over the cost of living drew 106,000 people according to the interior ministry, a lower turnout.
  • In the United States, air traffic remains heavily disrupted after the nationwide ground stop ordered on Friday by the aviation authority.
  • In rugby, Wales beat New Zealand 35-28 in Cardiff, a first in 73 years.

item.title: Saturday, November 14, 2026 · Ukraine: Europeans set to join next round of talks
item.description:
• According to US envoys, Europeans will take part in the next round of talks on Ukraine, but Moscow has not confirmed it.
  • Sébastien Lecornu opened a month of talks with civil service unions on Friday; they are keeping their November 17 strike, which the CFDT union has now joined.
  • In Guinea, clashes between security forces and gold miners left ten dead near Siguiri.
  • At COP31, three public finance institutions aim to raise $10 billion for climate projects by 2030.
  • France's rugby team beat South Africa 21-19 at the Stade de France.

item.title: Friday, November 13, 2026 · Jensen Huang steps down at Nvidia, Colette Kress takes over on an interim basis
item.description:
• Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang stepped down as head of the chip giant on Thursday, effective immediately; chief financial officer Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO.
  • Nvidia shares plunged about 13% at the open on Wall Street after the announcement.
  • US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner met Vladimir Putin at the Kremlin before joining Volodymyr Zelensky in Dublin.
  • In football, France suffered their first defeat of the Zidane era, losing 3-1 to Italy in Milan.

item.title: Thursday, November 12, 2026 · Ukraine: Moscow and Kyiv agree on a large prisoner exchange
item.description:
• Russia-Ukraine talks in Abu Dhabi ended on Wednesday with a deal on a large prisoner exchange, but no progress towards peace.
  • Emmanuel Macron led his last Armistice Day ceremony as head of state, amid a row over commemorations in schools.
  • At the COP31 summit in Antalya, António Guterres called for a climate justice pact.
  • Global fossil CO2 emissions are set to fall by 0.41% in 2026, according to the Global Carbon Budget.
  • In Paris, the CAC 40 rose 0.66% in a quiet session, with 11 November a public holiday.

item.title: Wednesday, November 11, 2026 · Ukraine: Russians, Ukrainians and Americans meet in Abu Dhabi
item.description:
• Russian, Ukrainian and US delegations opened a new round of peace talks in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday, mediated by Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.
  • In France, teachers, high-school pupils and university students were again called out on strike on Tuesday to demand more resources.
  • The Paris stock exchange gained 0.55% as oil prices fell, while chipmaker Nexperia says it can no longer keep up with demand.
  • In the Women's Champions League, it was a tough night for the Paris clubs: PSG lost 1-2 to Bayern and Paris FC lost 3-0 in Madrid.

item.title: Tuesday, November 10, 2026 · Minimum wage to rise 1.6% from December 1
item.description:
• Sébastien Lecornu announced on Monday, November 9, an early 1.6% rise in the minimum wage on December 1, to €1,502 net a month; the CGT union is calling a strike on November 17.
  • In Poland, the Kraków gunman, who killed six people on Saturday, died in hospital; authorities describe a far-right-inspired attack.
  • Europeans are set to join the US-brokered talks between Russia and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi, despite Kremlin objections.
  • COP31 opened in Antalya amid a dispute over climate finance, while the WMO confirms that 2015-2026 will be the warmest twelve-year period on record.
  • In Paris, the CAC 40 gained 1.16% on Monday as oil prices fell; on Wall Street, Nvidia lost about 4% after an investigation into its CEO was opened.

item.title: Monday, November 9, 2026 · Israel: Eisenkot tasked with forming the government
item.description:
• Israel: Gadi Eisenkot received the mandate on Sunday to form the next government, instead of Benjamin Netanyahu.
  • Ukraine: Russia steps up its strikes ahead of the Abu Dhabi talks on Tuesday.
  • In France, unions and employers meet at Matignon today for a social conference on wages.
  • COP31 opens today in Antalya; in sailing, Tom Laperche wins the Route du Rhum in record time.

item.title: Sunday, November 8, 2026 · Wall Street: the Nasdaq 100 has its worst day since 2020
item.description:
• The Nasdaq 100 had its worst session since 2020 on Thursday (−6.36%), despite a much stronger-than-expected US jobs report.
  • Israel: Gadi Eisenkot, recommended by 67 lawmakers, was due to receive the mandate to form the next government on Sunday.
  • In France, unions and employers meet at Matignon on Monday for a social conference on wages.
  • The COP31 climate conference opens on Monday, November 9, in Antalya, Türkiye.
